//lastChange: Multi-page pharmacy websites (2026-09-08). pageContent.js renders the body of every derived page, siteRender.js renders the whole site plus sitemap, robots and 404, and document.js gained canonical, og:url, og:image, Twitter cards, BreadcrumbList and Service schema — extended rather than duplicated, because two head assemblers drift and the way that shows up is a second canonical tag nobody can see. Migration 0051 adds pharmacy_website_pages: a table rather than a jsonb map so serving one page does not read every page on every crawler request. The 20 new tests are end-to-end on rendered HTML, because every failure they guard against is invisible in any single module: a duplicate description is correct behaviour in the function that produced it and a defect only when two pages are compared.
